purpose: Prevent analyst-forecast/Forward-PE research from treating source-family existence as a proven canonical PIT data contract.

sources.evidence: 2026 Taiwan Finance Research Letters study explicitly used monthly CMoney consensus forecasts; public CMoney pages expose dated broker EPS forecasts/ranges.
TEJ publicly documents Taiwan listed/OTC analyst EPS forecast-change and disagreement research and separately exposes API-capable data services.

Official filings, management forecasts/guidance, investor-conference disclosures and financial statements are available, but these are issuer/official disclosures rather than sell-side analyst consensus.
sources.role: event clock / actual fundamentals / management guidance / denominator validation

sources.evidence: Dated report pages can prove that a forecast was publicly visible, but public-page search is not guaranteed complete population coverage and may omit revisions/withdrawals.
sources.role: source-family corroboration and spot audit only

canonicalPromotionRequirements: individual forecast-level records or provider-equivalent immutable revision history
target fiscal period/horizon and forecast basis
broker/forecaster identity or stable deduplication key
publishedAt or provider-defined point-in-time eligibility timestamp
historical vintage retrieval or prospective immutable capture
fallbackRule: If no source meets canonical requirements, D07-11 and D08-04 stay L2; analyst consensus, revisions, Forward PE and PEG remain UNKNOWN in empirical System research.
noSubstitutionRules: Do not substitute issuer guidance for analyst consensus.
Do not substitute V8 marketConsensus for analyst earnings consensus.
Do not reconstruct historical consensus from today's latest analyst estimates.
Do not infer zero revision from missing coverage.
